card.name: This/a starting a sentence about a condition
card.fires_on: The word "This" (or "a") that begins a sentence or appositive right after a topic or condition has just been named, such as a syndrome, table, trial or article.

modes.label: Sentence-opening This
modes.description: "This" starts a sentence that refers back to the item just named, like a disorder, table, trial or article.
